project.description: The public API: the pipeline-building DSL (RenderPipeline + builder, Target), the RenderTechnique SPI and its realise/record contexts, and the VexelEngine facade. This is the front door a client writes against — composing a pipeline (a shared target + ordered techniques) and running it. Depends only on vexelray-core and the JDK; it exposes Vulkan handles as JDK primitives (long, MemorySegment) and never imports a Vulkan binding, so the contract stays substrate-light. See docs/refactor-decisions.md (D2, D3).
